description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
 Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation\-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
   

  

**Ramboll in India**
 Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Location \- Chennai/Gurugram Or Noida**
 We invite you to bring your knowledge of Drafting skills in Water and Wastewater Treatment into play as you will be responsible for carrying out the 2D drawings and 3D models related to water and wastewater treatment plants and shall be responsible for the technical quality of his/her own work . To succeed in this role, you must have knowledge of design software’s like AutoCAD, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Navisworks and Revit.. Are you our new Senior Principal Designer \- BIM, Water and Wastewater Treatment? Click the apply\-button to send your application.
   

  

**You will join our Water** 
**department**
 As our new
 **Senior Lead Designer – BIM, Water and Wastewater Treatment** 
 , you will be part of a global team of specialised water consultants support the development of sustainable societies. Principal Designer BIM, as a part of multi\-disciplinary projects team, is responsible to provide drafting support to technically challenging projects. Modeller would create 2D drawings and 3D models and should be responsible for the technical quality of his/her own work and would focus on compliance with project objectives and quality standards
   

  

 Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:
   

  

  

* Will work on detailed engineering drawings for a range of projects to create 2D drawing and 3D models and support other members of the drafting team in accomplishing complex tasks.
* Will need to coordinate with Team Lead / Project managers and/or engineers for draughting work in a given project.
* Will need to coordinate with the Principal Business Unit and distribute the workload to the BIM Designers Team and responsible for QA/QC of modelling related works
* Is responsible for technical correctness and timely delivery of the drawings and documents.
* Exercises self\-discipline and work ethics
* Respect and follow company policies and procedures


**Qualifications**
**Your starting point for constant growth**
 From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:
   

  

  

* Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or ITI Trained Professional with 5\-8 years of professional experience related to Water and Wastewater Treatment Plants.
* Strong knowledge of Auto CAD is essential, knowledge of software like AutoCAD Plant 3D, Revit and Navisworks would be essential.
* Good knowledge on ACC shall be desirable.
* experience in preparation of general arrangement drawings for various process units in 2D and 3D,
* General layouts, Hydraulic flow diagram, Piping layout, P\&ID is required. Preference will be given
* Confidentialfor the candidate having experience in preparing 3D models on AutoCAD Plant 3D and Revit Software’s.
* Basic knowledge of various process units of Water and Wastewater Treatment (W\&WWT)
* Technology and detailed knowledge of preparing various 2D drawings/3D models related to W\&WWT would be desirable.
* Good knowledge on the Pipe standards and Indian/International codes
* Good knowledge on the pipes, valves/sluice gates, fittings, pumps, blowers, mechanical screen, scraper mechanism, diffusers and other electromechanical equipment’s related to W\&WWT
* self\-motivated, team player and able to work independently with minimum supervision.
* Flexible attitude, in an environment with frequently changing deadlines can be relied on to meet deadlines.
* committed to both their work and personal development, with a willingness to widen their experience.
* Knowledge of Microsoft applications
* Good level of written and spoken Englis


 Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include self\-motivated, team player and able to work independently with minimum supervision.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Welcome to our Water division**
 At Ramboll, a global team of specialized water consultants support the development of sustainable societies. We assist our clients with their most challenging water management issues, delivering solutions that enable people and nature to flourish. Our main service areas cover Climate Adaptation \& Landscape Architecture, Water \& Wastewater Treatment, Water Resource Management, and Water \& Wastewater Networks.
   

  

**Ready to join us?**
 Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
   

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion is at the heart of what we do**
 We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.

title: Sr UX Designer II
description:
**Do you enjoy designing intuitive experiences for complex, data\-rich enterprise platforms used by research communities worldwide?**
**Do you thrive in fast\-moving, collaborative environments where your design decisions shape tools relied upon by thousands of academic editors?**
**About our Team:\-**
 Elsevier is a global leader in information and analytics, supporting researchers and healthcare professionals in advancing science and improving health outcomes. Our Digital Business Solutions (DBS) UX team works across a broad portfolio of research and editorial products, combining deep user empathy with rigorous design craft to build tools that genuinely serve the people who use them.
   

  

 The ERMS team is a cross\-functional group of product, engineering and UX professionals based across the UK, Amsterdam, and India, and works closely with editorial stakeholders across Elsevier's journal portfolio.
   

  

**About the Role:\-**
 As the Senior UX Designer you will be working on a number of key product areas; the main focus will be on the Editor Relationship Management System and its related Editor Portal, which are hosted on Salesforce and Salesforce Experience Cloud. You will own the design end\-to\-end, manage complex UX challenges, and deliver UI specifications. You will be an embedded member of the project team, collaborating closely with the Product Manager and development team throughout design, refinement, and build. You will also be supported by the wider DBS UX design team, who will help you onboard and provide design feedback throughout the engagement.We're looking for an exceptional designer who enjoys solving complex problems and creating elegant user experiences.
   

  

 You thrive in environments where not everything is fully defined. Rather than waiting for answers, you're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and work collaboratively to create clarity.
   

  

 Just as importantly, you're someone people enjoy working with. You have a low\-ego, highly collaborative mindset. You believe the best products are built together. You share your work early, actively seek feedback, challenge ideas and are just as happy seeing someone else's idea succeed as your own. Collaboration isn't something you do; it's simply how you work.
   

  

**Responsibilities:** 
 \-
   

  

* Collaborate closely with the entire project team — Product, Engineering, and stakeholders — to develop a comprehensive understanding of the project scope, infrastructure, and user needs.
* Review existing provision and develop new consolidated information architecture and flows based on core user tasks; user testing and iterating with regular user feedback.
* Understand and map current editorial workflows, identify pain points, and design solutions that improve usability and support smoother workflow transitions.
* Create design thinking and user understanding documents that demonstrate how existing functionality will be extended and mapped to meet user needs — transforming initial concepts into ready\-to\-ship features.
* Produce UX design and information architecture that meet the needs of the key user groups, working within the Elsevier design system.
* Build prototypes and define key user flows for testing and feedback, managing fast iterations based on regular user input.
* Define the portal’s look and feel using Elsevier design libraries and existing patterns, creating new components and patterns where needed.
* Develop a strategy for migrating existing workflows to the new system as part of a continuous delivery approach.
* Measure user feedback post\-launch and work with the Product Manager to scope and plan for future phases.


**Requirements:** 
 \-
   

  

* A portfolio demonstrating design experience covering User Research, UX, and UI design, with 12\-15 years of experience in enterprise systems.
* Proven experience in front\-end UX/UI design for complex, data\-rich platforms; experience with academic, editorial, or similar professional user groups is a bonus.
* Experience wire\-framing, prototyping, and creating detailed, customer\-focused designs, including knowledge of customer journey mapping techniques.
* High proficiency in Figma (Figma Make \+ AI approaches to design \& development): able to produce polished UX flows, design concepts, high\-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes.
* Excellent working knowledge of accessibility guidelines (WCAG) and demonstrable ability to produce WCAG 2\.2 AA\-compliant designs.
* Strong skills in user research and user testing, with hands\-on experience running sessions and incorporating feedback into design iterations.
* Ability to interpret user analytics and research data, adopting a data\-driven approach to creative problem\-solving.
* Comfortable with both tactical and strategic UX work — able to zoom in on interaction detail and zoom out to consider broader information architecture and system design.
* Experience applying an incremental product design process in an Agile environment.
* Experience using and contributing to pattern libraries and design systems (experience with the Graphene design system or Salesforce Experience Cloud is advantageous).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate design concepts to a range of audiences and communicate persuasively at a strategic level.
* Ability to work collaboratively with diverse, global, cross\-functional and cross\-cultural teams.
* Enthusiasm for joining a collaborative UX team with a human\-centred approach.


**Good to have**
* Experience designing AI\-powered products or AI\-assisted workflows.
* Experience using AI in your design process, such as rapid prototyping, vibe coding, Spec\-Driven Development (SDD), or similar approaches.
* Experience contributing to design systems.


**Work in a way that works for you: \-**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long\-term goals.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
   

  

**Working for you: \-**
**Benefits**
 At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy
* Generous long\-service awards
* New Baby gift
* Subsidized food provided (applies to India\- Chennai)
* Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India\-Chennai)


**About Us:** 
 \-
   

  

 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s.
   

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
**Location:** 
 Chennai, India (Hybrid) \|
 **Employment:** 
 Full\-time \|
 **Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



  




 About Marklytics
 
 Marklytics builds Digital Product Passport (DPP), product traceability and regulatory compliance platforms for global manufacturers in the battery, automotive and materials sectors.
 



  




 The Role
 
 You will be our
 **first and only designer** 
 . There is no design team, design system or process to inherit, so you will build all of it.You will own the full user experience across our products: the web platform used by manufacturers and compliance teams, the admin and configuration tools, and the public\-facing passport views consumers see when they scan a QR code on a product. You will work directly with the CTO, product and engineering leads, and the delivery team, and your decisions will ship to production quickly.This role suits someone who wants ownership, is comfortable with ambiguity, and moves easily between high\-level product thinking and pixel\-level detail in the same week.
 



  




 What You Will Own
 
**Product design, end to end** 



* Take features from problem definition to shipped product: discovery, user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and high\-fidelity UI
* Design data\-heavy B2B interfaces, including dashboards, data tables, multi\-step onboarding and submission workflows, role\-based access views and audit trails
* Turn dense regulatory requirements into workflows users can complete without a manual
* Design public passport pages that are clear, accessible and credible on any device



**Design system and standards** 



* Build Marklytics' design system from scratch: foundations, tokens, components, patterns and documentation
* Keep the design system consistent across a multi\-tenant platform and client\-specific deployments, including white\-label and on\-premise variants
* Set up the design process: how work is briefed, reviewed, handed off and QA'd



**Collaboration and delivery** 



* Work with engineers daily to scope work, make trade\-offs and review builds for design accuracy
* Produce clear handoff specs covering states, edge cases, responsive behaviour and interactions
* Talk to clients and end users to understand their workflows, and run lightweight usability testing



**Beyond the product** 



* Support sales and pre\-sales with product demos, clickable prototypes and design concepts for proposals
* Contribute to brand and marketing design as needed, such as pitch decks, the website and product collateral
* Help shape the design function as the company grows, including future design hires


 What We Are Looking For
 
**Must have** 



* 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX or product design, with at least 2 years on B2B, SaaS or enterprise web products
* A portfolio with case studies that show your thinking (problem, constraints, options, decisions and outcome)
* Proven experience designing complex, data\-dense interfaces such as tables, filters, forms, dashboards and permission\-based views
* Advanced Figma skills: components, variants, auto\-layout, variables and interactive prototyping
* Experience building or significantly contributing to a design system
* Strong visual design skills, including typography, layout, hierarchy and attention to detail
* Working knowledge of accessibility (WCAG 2\.1 AA) and responsive design
* Ability to explain and defend design decisions to engineers, founders and clients
* Self\-direction: you can prioritise your own work without a design manager



  





**Good to have** 



* Experience as an early or sole designer at a startup
* Exposure to compliance, supply chain, manufacturing, sustainability, climate\-tech or regulated industries
* Understanding of front\-end development (HTML, CSS, React) and how designs are built
* Experience with user research methods and usability testing
* Brand, marketing or presentation design experience
* Experience working with distributed or international teams across time zones

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**About IshqME** 




 IshqME is a D2C Indian women's fashion brand based in Chennai. We design handcrafted apparel, 925 sterling silver jewellery, and crochet bags for women who would rather own a few meaningful pieces than a closet full of forgettable ones. Our tagline is Love Who You Are, and we mean it.
 



 We're a small, fast\-moving team where the work you do actually ships. No layers of approval. No designing things that sit in a folder. If you make it, people see it.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for a Graphic Designer with 2\-4 years of experience to join our marketing team. You'll be the person behind how IshqME looks across every touchpoint: emails, social media, ads, packaging, the website, campaign creatives, and everything in between.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You'll work directly with the founder and the marketing lead, not through a brief that passes through five people. You'll see your work go live the same week you make it.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




 Design email campaigns, WhatsApp templates, and landing pages that feel like IshqME, not like a Shopify default.
 



 Create social media graphics, ad creatives, and story templates for Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
 



 Design promotional materials for seasonal campaigns (Diwali, Navratri, new collection launches) across digital and print.
 



 Maintain and evolve the brand's visual identity. We have a brand deck and established design language. Your job is to protect it and push it forward.
 



 Work on product photography edits, retouching, and creating lifestyle mockups for the website and marketing materials.
 



 Design packaging, labels, tags, and inserts that feel thoughtful and on\-brand.
 



 Build visual assets for the website: banners, collection pages, landing pages, pop\-ups.
 



 Collaborate on campaign concepts from the idea stage, not just the execution stage. We want a designer who thinks, not just one who takes orders.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 2\-4 years of experience in graphic design. D2C, fashion, or lifestyle brand experience is a strong plus.
 



 Strong portfolio showing brand\-consistent work across digital and print. We'll look at this more than your resume.
 



 Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Familiarity with Canva for quick turnarounds is fine too.
 



 An eye for editorial design, typography, and colour. IshqME's visual language is warm, editorial, and intentional. If your portfolio is full of neon SaaS landing pages, this probably isn't the right fit.
 



 Photo editing and retouching skills. You don't need to be a photographer, but you need to know your way around product photo editing.
 



 Ability to work fast without dropping quality. We're a small team. Things move quickly. You'll often go from brief to final in the same day.
 



 Good communication and an openness to feedback. You'll be working directly with the founders. The feedback loop is short and direct.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 Experience with email template design (HTML email layouts, mobile\-responsive design).
 



 Basic motion graphics or video editing skills (for social media reels/stories).
 



 Understanding of how design drives conversion in e\-commerce (CTAs, above\-the\-fold hierarchy, mobile\-first thinking).
 



  





**What we offer** 




 A seat at the table. Your work shapes how a growing brand looks and feels to the world.
 



 A creative environment with high\-quality brand photography, an established design system, and a founder who genuinely cares about design.
 



 The chance to build a portfolio of work that actually went live and actually performed, not spec work that sat in a pitch deck.
 



 Chennai\-based, in\-office. We believe design is better when the team is in the same room.

title: UX Designer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We are seeking a talented UX Designer (Grade 26\) to join the UX Design team for Optum® Crimson AI \- an AI\-enabled clinical analytics and business intelligence platform used by hospitals and health systems across the U.S. Crimson AI integrates directly with a health system's EHR and brings clinical, financial, scheduling and supply chain data together into a single modular platform, layering predictive analytics, AI\-generated recommendations and a conversational AI experience on top of it. Analysis that once required weeks of manual data mining is now delivered in seconds.
   

  

 This is a design role in which data is the product. Our users come to Crimson AI to identify an opportunity, understand what is driving it, and decide what to do next. Your work makes that path short, clear and trustworthy.
   

  

 The role combines user experience design, product thinking, data visualization and AI\-enabled design capabilities to deliver solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science and Business stakeholders, you will contribute to the design and evolution of complex digital products, transforming user insights and business requirements into engaging and effective experiences.
   

  

 We work in short, iterative cycles in each Sprint. Designers here are active participants in shaping the work rather than recipients of finished specifications \- you will help the team arrive at clarity rather than wait for it. Because our products sit on top of complex healthcare data and rapidly evolving AI capabilities, Product, Design, Data Science and Engineering deliberately open up a problem space together to build shared understanding, then converge quickly on a direction and deliver.
   

  

 We are a closely knit team that shares work early, critiques generously and holds a high bar for craft. You will have real ownership of your product areas, direct access to the people who understand the data and the domain, and colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving these problems together.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Create wireframes, prototypes, design concepts and high\-fidelity designs that effectively communicate product vision and functionality
* Apply user\-centered design methodologies to ensure usability, accessibility, and adoption
* Build a thorough working understanding of the product and the business behind it, and ask the incisive early questions that establish the real user problem, the intended business outcome and the measures of success \- then design against those rather than against a feature list
* Translate complex, multi\-source healthcare data into actionable insight. Develop a working understanding of how the underlying data relates \- what drives what, what can meaningfully be compared, and where the caveats sit \- and design the information hierarchy, data presentation and visualizations so that users can see the signal, trust it, and act on it
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis and user discovery activities to inform product and design decisions
* Translate complex business requirements, workflows, and data structures into intuitive and user\-friendly experiences
* Incorporate customer feedback, user research findings and market insights to refine designs and improve product outcomes
* Operate at pace: scope your own design approach, select the right fidelity for the decision at hand, and iterate as the team's understanding of the problem sharpens
* Perform AI\-driven product design and prototyping, and apply AI tooling to accelerate your own exploration and delivery
* Follow and help strengthen the defined UX guidelines, standards, and best practices across teams
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams throughout the product lifecycle to deliver high\-quality user experiences
* Participate in usability testing, stakeholder workshops, design reviews, and design\-thinking sessions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment) The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in UX / Product Design, including hands\-on experience designing for data\-rich or analytics\-driven products
* Hands\-on experience with user research, usability testing, stakeholder workshops, and design sprint activities
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG / Section 508\) and inclusive design principles
* Proficiency in Figma and other industry\-standard design and prototyping tools
* Demonstrated product thinking: a track record of understanding product and business requirements quickly, asking the right questions of stakeholders, and producing design solutions that demonstrably serve both user needs and business goals. Portfolio should evidence the reasoning, not only the screens
* Proven ability to work with data hierarchy, data architecture and complex data relationships and to propose best\-in\-class designs for presenting them cdashboards, drill\-downs, comparative and benchmarked views, and insight\-led layouts that lead users to a decision
* Proven ability to work with self\-direction in areas of ambiguity: you can take an early or evolving problem statement, structure it, seek out the information you need, and move it forward without every step being defined for you
* Proven ability to work effectively in a high\-velocity, cross\-functional environment \- responsive to new information, efficient in revision, and pragmatic about sequencing what ships now versus what follows
* Proven ability to communicate product and design intent through demo\-ready prototypes and clear narrative \- work that travels well to customers, executives and internal stakeholders
* Proven ability to translate user needs, business goals and technical constraints into thoughtful design solutions
* Proven solid collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to product, engineering, data science and business audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of experience building products in the US healthcare analytics domain, with familiarity with clinical workflows, healthcare data platforms, interoperability standards or population health analytics
* Experience designing for probabilistic or predictive outputs \- communicating confidence, uncertainty and recommendation provenance so that users know how much to trust what they are seeing
* Experience partnering with Product / Data Science / ML teams and defining success metrics for AI\-driven experiences, including generative AI, predictive analytics, conversational interfaces and intelligent workflows
* Knowledge of data visualization best practices and experience designing complex dashboards, reporting and analytics solutions

Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
*\#NJP*
